decisions.reason: The firm has visibly committed to this service over two years on its own webpage and it fits tightly with its core e-commerce relaunch and performance-marketing offer, so management is likely to continue it and explain any weak uptake as temporary demand variation.

Although newer and therefore less sunk-cost intensive than Product D, the workshops are still a publicly presented extension of the firm's SEO capabilities and are close enough to its main business that management would be inclined to retain them unless results quickly disappoint.
